tagline: Leading global distribution and outsourcing services provider
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the Hero because it reflects Bunzl's core commitment to supply chain traceability and ethics, a key trust driver for its customers in sensitive sectors.

kpis.name: Percentage of risk-based procurement covered by audits
kpis.explanation: Percentage of procurement from high-risk regions that has been processed through assessed and compliant suppliers.
kpis.description: Bunzl achieved its strategic goal of covering 90% of risk-based procurement with assessed suppliers, demonstrating continuous improvement in ethical diligence.
kpis.signal: 93% of risk-based spend covered in 2025, versus 89% in 2024.

kpis.name: Number of suppliers audited
kpis.explanation: Total number of suppliers assessed under Bunzl's ethical audit program.
kpis.description: Expansion of the audit program strengthens transparency and compliance across the supply chain.
kpis.signal: 1,430 suppliers audited in 2025, up from the prior year.

kpis.name: Number of direct suppliers
kpis.explanation: Total number of suppliers with which Bunzl works directly.
kpis.description: Bunzl collaborates with more than 15,000 direct suppliers, primarily at Tier 1 level, where its influence is strongest.

kpis.name: Countries of operation
kpis.explanation: Number of countries where Bunzl operates.
kpis.description: Bunzl operates in more than 30 countries across the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the United Kingdom.

risks.title: Operational execution in North America
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language ("execution issues", "challenging"), upward trend versus 2024, high weight due to Bunzl's largest market.

risks.title: Dependence on sensitive sectors
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention in market segments, moderate but concerning language ("more significant impact"), stable trend, important category for strategy.

risks.title: Competition in own-brand offerings
risks.score_rationale: Secondary but clear position in the report, assertive language ("underpenetrated own brand levels"), upward trend, growing strategic weight.

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: Mention in growth strategy, positive but cautious language ("slower year for total spend"), stable trend, key category for external growth.

risks.title: Pressure on operating margins
risks.score_rationale: Key financial data (7.7% margin), concerned language ("declined", "pressure"), stable trend after deterioration, high financial weight.

risks.title: Business model resilience
risks.score_rationale: Mention in CEO and Chairman remarks, reassuring but defensive language ("re-establishing resilience"), improving trend, cross-functional category.

risks.title: Dependence on sustainable suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Clear strategic objective (90% of suppliers assessed), committed language ("committed", "high risk regions"), upward trend, growing ESG weight.
